args.message: I couldn't produce a daily breakdown from monthly_rev. That summary adds up order amounts by month, so January 2025 is stored as one row dated 2025-01-01, and the daily detail is gone. When I asked for daily figures, the query was refused because data grouped by month can't be split into days. For daily revenue, the summary would need to be rebuilt from the underlying orders data at day level, for example by adding up order amounts per day for January 2025.
